messages:
maya: heads-up: saw a request being charged to both project and org when routed through api-proxy with SA coalescing.
ron: can you paste a minimal flow?
maya: trimmed flow:
-> proxy recv x-api-key=svc-AB12
-> auth lookup -> sa@proj-77 org=org-3
-> coalesce -> effective_identity=sa:svc-AB12@proj-77
-> router -> billing.project=proj-77
-> quota increments project:proj-77
-> quota increments org:org-3
ron: quota service seems to treat audit-origin headers as attribution too. proxy leaves X-Orig-Project/X-Orig-Org for logs.
kevin: yep current precedence is "any header wins". we should prefer effective_identity if present.
anita: proposal: quota selection priority = 1) effective_identity, 2) origin headers only if no effective. add tag auth_route=coalesced|orig.
maya: telemetry: we need a sampled fallback metric requests.auth.attribution_fallback{reason="no_effective"} and a coalesced_count. include proxy_version label.
kevin: rollout constraints: no retroactive billing. add quota_preview_mode that logs WOULD_BE_CHARGED and doesn't bill until 100% ramp.
ron: rollout plan behind feature flag auth_coalesce_v2: enable metrics in sandbox -> 1% staging (by project hash) with preview mode -> monitor 48h -> ramp 10/50/100.
anita: Console: small panel "Attribution drift" with mismatch rate, top proxies, top projects/orgs. product wants drilldown to request traces.
maya: retention: detailed traces 7d, aggregated metrics 90d.
kevin: action items:
- kevin: patch quota precedence + preview mode
- ron: add proxy_version tag + header toggle in proxy
- anita: console mock + canary playbook
- maya: run sandbox and collect baseline
dev-bot: checklist added: feature_flag=auth_coalesce_v2 metric_keys=[requests.auth.coalesced_count,requests.auth.attribution_fallback], quota_preview_mode
maya: thanks, sync tomorrow 10:30 to review sandbox numbers :thumbsup:
